content: QA Wolf is an AI managed QA platform. AI explores the app to discover workflows and generate a coverage map, writes maintainable test code across web, iOS, Android, APIs, Salesforce, MCP servers, feature flags, email or SMS verification, and GenAI eval. Unlimited parallel runs, DAG orchestration, video and trace logs per run. A human QA team triages failures and fixes broken tests. Integrates with CI/CD, Jira, Slack, Teams.
